findings.quoted_text: The parties agree that the Hotel shall provide Group with menus and pricing no later than twenty-four (24) months prior to the Event dates. Any menus and prices quoted by the Hotel within the twenty-four (24) months window may not be changed by the Hotel without Group's written consent, except as provided herein. Pricing quoted outside this window may be revised at the Hotel's discretion.
findings.headline: Menu pricing locked 24 months out, earlier than standard
findings.finding_text: Pricing is set 24 months before the event and is only protected inside that window, so the group commits to menu prices much earlier than the 12-month standard, with revision exposure outside the window. CD's position fixes pricing no earlier than 12 months out or at pricing in effect on signing.
findings.cd_standard: Menu prices confirmed at Hotel's pricing in effect on the date of the Agreement, or established not earlier than 12 months prior to the Event.
findings.proposed_language: Menu prices for the Event's food and beverage functions will be confirmed at the Hotel's pricing in effect on the date of this Agreement, or established not earlier than twelve (12) months prior to the Event, and may not be changed by the Hotel without Group's written consent.
findings.redline_note: Menu pricing is fixed at signing or no earlier than twelve months out, then protected from change.
findings.compromise_range: Shortfall billed at 35–50% of the gap. Menu pricing locked 6–12 months before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: If Group's actual food and beverage consumption during the Event Period falls short of the minimum guarantee, Group shall pay the shortfall in full.
findings.headline: F&B shortfall billed at 100% of the gap
findings.finding_text: Group pays the full dollar shortfall rather than a fraction of it, and no F&B from affiliates or exhibitors is credited toward the minimum.
findings.cd_standard: Shortfall billed at 35% of the difference; affiliate and exhibitor F&B counts toward the minimum.
findings.proposed_language: If Group's actual food and beverage consumption during the Event Period falls short of the minimum guarantee, Group shall pay Hotel thirty-five percent (35%) of the difference between actual revenue and the minimum, not the full shortfall. Food and beverage revenue from all affiliate organizations and exhibitors meeting in conjunction with Group's event will count toward the minimum.
findings.compromise_range: Shortfall billed at 35–50% of the gap. Menu pricing locked 6–12 months before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: The shortfall payment rate shall be one hundred percent (100%) of the difference between the minimum guarantee and actual consumption.
findings.headline: Shortfall rate restated at 100% of difference
findings.finding_text: This sentence separately fixes the shortfall rate at 100%, which must be changed along with the earlier sentence so the clause does not contradict itself.
findings.cd_standard: Shortfall billed at 35% of the difference.
findings.proposed_language: The shortfall payment rate shall be thirty-five percent (35%) of the difference between the minimum guarantee and actual consumption.
findings.redline_note: The stated shortfall rate is aligned to the revised percentage.
findings.compromise_range: Shortfall billed at 35–50% of the gap. Menu pricing locked 6–12 months before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall engage for all services at the Hotel only vendors appointed exclusively by the Hotel or operating as part of the Hotel's in-house service divisions, and Group shall not retain, contract with, or permit on the Hotel's premises any outside vendor, supplier, decorator, caterer, audiovisual provider, florist, musician, photographer, or other service provider without the Hotel's prior written consent. Group's use of any outside vendor in violation of this requirement shall incur a surcharge of $2,500.00 for each such engagement.
findings.headline: In-house vendors mandatory; $2,500 surcharge per outside vendor
findings.finding_text: The group must use Hotel-appointed vendors for every service and pays $2,500 per outside engagement, removing price competition and the group's choice of suppliers.
findings.cd_standard: Group may use the supplier of its choice at no fee or surcharge; in-house vendors are not mandatory.
findings.proposed_language: Group reserves the right to utilize the supplier of its choice, at no additional service fee or surcharge, for services or rentals including but not limited to audio-visual, exhibit decorating, security, floral, transportation, and tours. Hotel's in-house vendors are not mandatory for any service category.
findings.redline_note: Group may select its own vendors without added fees or surcharges.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group engage an outside vendor in contravention of this clause, Group shall pay the stated surcharge in addition to any costs incurred by the Hotel in addressing the unauthorized service provision.
findings.headline: Outside-vendor penalty plus open-ended Hotel costs
findings.finding_text: Beyond the surcharge, Group pays any costs the Hotel claims to incur over an outside vendor, which must be removed with the surcharge.
findings.cd_standard: Outside vendors permitted with no surcharge or fee.
findings.proposed_language: Group's use of an outside vendor is permitted and shall not result in any surcharge or additional cost to Group.
findings.redline_note: Use of outside vendors carries no surcharge or added cost.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall provide complimentary room nights to Group based on a ratio of one (1) complimentary room per seventy-five (75) paid room nights occupied during the Event Period.
findings.headline: Complimentary rooms earned at 1 per 75, not 1 per 40
findings.finding_text: The ratio is nearly half as generous as the standard and counts only paid nights.
findings.cd_standard: One complimentary room per 40 occupied, revenue-producing room nights, cumulative across the whole block, with miscoded rooms and no-show/cancellation fee nights counted.
findings.proposed_language: The Hotel shall provide one (1) complimentary room for every forty (40) occupied, revenue-producing room nights actualized, calculated cumulatively across the entire room block (total room nights divided by 40). All occupied rooms will be counted toward Group's pickup, including rooms credited to Group through a room block audit, and each no-show fee and cancellation fee charged will be credited as one (1) room night toward Group's pickup.
findings.redline_note: Complimentary rooms are earned cumulatively at a stated ratio with all occupied rooms counted.
findings.compromise_range: One complimentary room per 40–50 occupied room nights.

findings.quoted_text: The complimentary room ratio of seventy-five (75) stated above is a guideline only and does not create an entitlement in Group. The award and allocation of any complimentary rooms shall be at the sole and absolute discretion of the Hotel, and the Hotel may elect to award fewer complimentary rooms than the guideline ratio would suggest or may decline to award complimentary rooms altogether. The Hotel may withdraw or reduce complimentary room credits at any time without notice. Group waives any claim for complimentary rooms in excess of those actually awarded by the Hotel.
findings.headline: Complimentary rooms are purely discretionary and withdrawable
findings.finding_text: The ratio is stated as a guideline only, so the Hotel can award fewer or none and withdraw credits without notice, making the concession illusory.
findings.cd_standard: Complimentary rooms earned on a clear formula tied to actual pickup, not left to Hotel discretion.
findings.proposed_language: Complimentary rooms earned under this clause are an entitlement of Group, are not subject to withdrawal or reduction by the Hotel, and Hotel will provide complimentary internet in attendees' guest rooms, regardless of brand loyalty program participation.
findings.redline_note: Complimentary rooms are a firm entitlement and in-room internet is included.
findings.compromise_range: One complimentary room per 40–50 occupied room nights.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group fail to meet its room block commitment during the Event Period, all complimentary room credits earned under this clause shall be forfeited in their entirety. Attrition shall be measured by comparing the actual room nights occupied to the room block specified in this Agreement. If actual occupancy falls below one hundred percent (100%) of the block, Group shall lose all complimentary room benefits, and the Hotel shall be relieved of any obligation to provide or credit complimentary rooms.
findings.headline: Comp rooms forfeited if pickup is even one room short of block
findings.finding_text: Complimentary rooms are lost at any shortfall below 100% of block, so the group pays attrition and also loses the concession for the same shortfall. This compounds the attrition clause, which already triggers at 90%.
findings.cd_standard: Complimentary rooms earned cumulatively regardless of whether the contracted block was otherwise met.
findings.proposed_language: Complimentary rooms earned under this clause will be provided regardless of whether Group's contracted room block was otherwise met.
findings.redline_note: Complimentary rooms are earned on actual pickup regardless of block attainment.
findings.compromise_range: One complimentary room per 40–50 occupied room nights.

findings.quoted_text: Complimentary rooms shall be allocated at standard rate and shall be subject to all applicable taxes, service charges, gratuities, resort fees, and other charges as if the rooms were paid.
findings.headline: Complimentary rooms still carry taxes, service charges and resort fees
findings.finding_text: Charging full fees on complimentary rooms erodes the value of the concession.
findings.cd_standard: Complimentary rooms earned on a clear formula, not eroded by fees.
findings.proposed_language: Complimentary rooms shall be provided at no charge to Group, exclusive of applicable taxes.
findings.redline_note: Complimentary rooms are provided without service charges or resort fees.
findings.compromise_range: One complimentary room per 40–50 occupied room nights.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel reserves the right to impose additional fees, surcharges, and service charges upon Group at any time, including without limitation after the execution of this Agreement. Such fees and surcharges may include, without limitation, facility fees, energy surcharges, sustainability fees, labor surcharges, and other operational charges that the Hotel may add at its discretion. Group shall pay all such fees as added to its bills, whether or not such fees were disclosed prior to Group's signature on this Agreement.
findings.headline: Hotel may add undisclosed fees after signing
findings.finding_text: The Hotel can add any fee at any time without disclosure or approval, leaving the group's cost open-ended.
findings.cd_standard: All charges disclosed in writing before signature; undisclosed charges waived; later add-ons need written approval.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will disclose in writing, prior to execution of this Agreement, all charges that may be associated with the Event based on the meeting requirements provided by Group, including but not limited to resort fees, surcharges, shipping and delivery charges, electrical charges, telephone access charges, porterage, rigging, signage, sponsorship or conference branding and marketing, and meeting setup or rental charges. Any charge not disclosed to Group in writing prior to signature is waived. Should Group require additional services or equipment after signature, Hotel must obtain Group's written approval before providing the service and before posting the charge to the master account.
findings.redline_note: All charges are disclosed before signing; later additions require written approval.

findings.quoted_text: Fees and surcharges disclosed in writing to Group prior to execution of this Agreement shall appear on final invoices as described. All fees and surcharges, whether pre-disclosed or introduced after execution, shall be due and payable by Group. Group waives any claim that undisclosed charges are unenforceable or that such charges constitute a material modification of the Agreement. The Hotel's right to add fees shall not be limited by prior disclosures or the absence thereof.
findings.headline: Group waives objections to undisclosed charges
findings.finding_text: Group gives up any challenge to charges it was never told about, which removes the only check on the clause above.
findings.cd_standard: Any charge not disclosed by signature is waived outright.
findings.proposed_language: Fees and surcharges disclosed in writing to Group prior to execution of this Agreement shall appear on final invoices as described. Any fee or surcharge not so disclosed is waived and shall not be payable by Group.
findings.redline_note: Only fees disclosed before signing are payable.

findings.quoted_text: A resort fee of $35.00 per occupied room per night shall be charged to all rooms in the block. This resort fee is in addition to all room rates and shall be applied to every room night, including complimentary room nights that Group may receive.
findings.headline: $35 nightly resort fee charged on every room including comps
findings.finding_text: A $35 nightly resort fee applies to every block room, including complimentary nights, adding about 12% to the $289 rate.
findings.cd_standard: Resort fees waived for attendees with resort-fee services still honored; no early check-in or checked-bag fees.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will waive the resort fee for all attendees while continuing to honor the resort fee services. Hotel will not charge attendees an early check-in fee when their room type is available, and will waive checked-bag fees for attendees arriving before check-in time or departing after check-out time.

findings.location_section: 23. Change of Brand, Management or Ownership
findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide written notice to the Group in the event of a change in the Hotel's brand affiliation, management company, ownership, or controlling interest; provided, however, that the Hotel shall provide such notice no later than ninety (90) days prior to the effective date of any such change, to the extent practicable and permitted by the Hotel's corporate counsel and applicable law.
findings.headline: Change notice is best-efforts and qualified, not firm
findings.finding_text: Notice is only a commercially reasonable effort and conditioned on practicability and counsel's approval, so the group may never receive it.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel must notify Group in writing within 30 days of a material change in ownership, management or brand, or of bankruptcy or foreclosure.
findings.proposed_language: Should Hotel undergo a material change in ownership, management company, or brand affiliation, or file for bankruptcy, or have foreclosure occur, Hotel will inform Group in writing within thirty (30) days of such change or filing.
findings.redline_note: Hotel gives firm written notice of any ownership, management, brand, or insolvency change.
findings.compromise_range: Hotel notice within 30–60 days of the change. Group's termination window of at least 30 days after notice.

findings.location_section: 23. Change of Brand, Management or Ownership
findings.quoted_text: Upon receipt of notice of a material change in brand, management, or ownership, the Group shall have the right to terminate this Agreement by providing written notice to the Hotel within ten (10) days of receipt of such notice, and such termination shall be effective upon receipt by the Hotel. Failure to provide termination notice within the ten (10) day period shall be deemed acceptance of the change and waiver of the Group's right to terminate on this ground.
findings.headline: Only 10 days to terminate after change, no refund
findings.finding_text: The group has a 10-day window rather than 30, no stated absence of liability, and no refund of deposits.
findings.cd_standard: Group may terminate without liability within 30 days of notice; deposits refunded within 5 days.
findings.proposed_language: Group may, at its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement without liability within thirty (30) days of receiving that notice. Hotel will refund all deposits and prepayments made by Group within five (5) days of the notice of termination.
findings.compromise_range: Hotel notice within 30–60 days of the change. Group's termination window of at least 30 days after notice.

findings.location_section: 23. Change of Brand, Management or Ownership
findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, the Group acknowledges that the Hotel may be subject to bankruptcy, foreclosure, receivership, or other insolvency proceedings, and that such events shall not trigger any notice requirement, termination right, or remedy available to the Group.
findings.headline: Bankruptcy and foreclosure carry no notice or exit right
findings.finding_text: Insolvency events are expressly excluded from notice and termination, leaving deposits exposed.
findings.cd_standard: Bankruptcy and foreclosure trigger notice within 30 days and a no-liability termination right.
findings.proposed_language: Bankruptcy, foreclosure, receivership, or other insolvency proceedings affecting the Hotel shall trigger the notice requirement and the Group's right to terminate without liability set out in this Agreement.
findings.redline_note: Insolvency events trigger notice and the Group's termination right.
findings.compromise_range: Hotel notice within 30–60 days of the change. Group's termination window of at least 30 days after notice.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel may apply the security deposit, or such portion thereof as necessary, against any attrition charges, food and beverage shortfalls, damages to the Hotel's premises, incidental costs, outstanding room charges, service failures, cancellation penalties, or any other sum that the Group owes to the Hotel under this Agreement or arising from the Group's occupancy and use of the Hotel's facilities.
findings.headline: Deposit can be applied to attrition, F&B shortfall and cancellation
findings.finding_text: The $25,000 deposit is commingled with unrelated charges, including attrition, F&B shortfalls and cancellation penalties.
findings.cd_standard: Deposit may not be applied toward attrition, cancellation, or F&B minimum shortfalls.
findings.proposed_language: The Hotel may apply the security deposit only against specific, documented damage to the Hotel's premises caused by Group or its attendees beyond normal wear and tear. The deposit may not be applied toward attrition, cancellation, or F&B minimum shortfalls.
findings.redline_note: Deposit secures documented damage only and is not applied to other charges.
findings.compromise_range: Refunded within 30–45 days of departure.

findings.quoted_text: Any remaining balance of the security deposit shall be refunded to the Group within ninety (90) days following the last day of the Event, provided that all invoices have been paid in full, all obligations have been satisfied, and no claims for damages are then pending.
findings.headline: Deposit refund takes 90 days and is conditional
findings.finding_text: Refund comes after 90 days, conditioned on all obligations and no pending claims, versus the 30-day standard absent itemized damage.
findings.cd_standard: Refund in full within 30 days unless Hotel provides an itemized accounting of documented damage.
findings.proposed_language: Any security deposit collected under this Agreement will be refunded in full within thirty (30) days of the Event's conclusion unless the Hotel provides Group with an itemized accounting of specific, documented damage caused by Group or its attendees beyond normal wear and tear.
findings.redline_note: Deposit is refunded within thirty days absent itemized documented damage.
findings.compromise_range: Refunded within 30–45 days of departure.

findings.quoted_text: Group may terminate this Agreement only for material breach by the Hotel that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice. Termination for such cause does not relieve Group of liability for damages, including lost profit, diminution in value, and consequential loss incurred by the Hotel as a result of Group's election to terminate.
findings.headline: Group can terminate only for uncured breach, still paying damages
findings.finding_text: Termination is limited to uncured material breach, and even then Group owes lost profit and consequential damages, so there is no true walk-away right.
findings.cd_standard: Group may terminate without liability and with a prompt refund for force majeure, epidemic, labor dispute, ownership change, renovation interference, facility reductions, unavailable convention center, or discriminatory legislation.
findings.proposed_language: Group may terminate this Agreement without liability, and Hotel will refund all deposits and prepayments within five (5) days, upon any of the following: (a) force majeure as defined in this Agreement; (b) Group's determination that COVID-19 or any other infectious disease outbreak, epidemic, or pandemic is affecting Group's ability to hold the Event as intended; (c) a labor dispute involving Hotel's employees arising within ninety (90) days of or during the Event; (d) a material change in Hotel's ownership, management company, or brand affiliation, or Hotel's bankruptcy or foreclosure; (e) renovation or remodeling that Group determines will interfere with its meeting; (f) a reduction in Hotel's facilities or services for which no mutually agreeable alternative is reached within thirty (30) days; (g) the convention center or overflow hotels on which the Event depends not being open, available, and fully operational over the Event dates; or (h) the adoption of state or local legislation that permits discrimination against attendees on any basis protected under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding the grounds upon which Group effects termination, whether for cause, convenience, or otherwise, any and all termination by Group shall be deemed and treated as a cancellation subject to the cancellation damages scale set forth in this Agreement. Group acknowledges that termination and cancellation are not distinct events but rather the same occurrence governed by a single damages regime. The cancellation scale shall apply to every termination regardless of its cause, and Group waives any argument that termination for cause stands outside the cancellation framework. The Hotel's right to cancellation damages shall not be diminished by Group's assertion that the Hotel committed a material breach.
findings.headline: Every termination, even for Hotel breach, triggers cancellation damages
findings.finding_text: Even a termination caused by the Hotel's own breach is charged as a cancellation, so the group pays up to 100% of room revenue for the Hotel's default.
findings.cd_standard: Termination for cause is entirely separate from, and never triggers, the cancellation clause's liquidated damages.
findings.proposed_language: None of the foregoing termination rights triggers the liquidated-damages calculation in the cancellation clause.
findings.redline_note: Termination for cause is separate from cancellation and carries no liquidated damages.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall provide pickup reports to Group showing room occupancy, rate structure, and charges incurred under the room block only upon Group's written request and at the Hotel's convenience, and no regular or periodic reporting shall be deemed a condition of this Agreement. Group shall not have a right to receive weekly, daily, or real-time updates on room block performance, and the Hotel reserves the right to provide such information in summary form and at intervals it deems appropriate.
findings.headline: No regular pickup reports; only on request in summary
findings.finding_text: The group gets no weekly pickup reporting ahead of cutoff, limiting its ability to manage the block and attrition.
findings.cd_standard: Weekly pickup report starting 60 days before cutoff; final pickup reports with documentation within 10 days of departure.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel and Group will review the room block in writing twenty-four (24) months prior to arrival and again twelve (12) months prior to arrival; at Group's sole discretion, Group may increase or decrease the room block by up to ten percent (10%) at each review and twenty percent (20%) cumulatively, at the group rate. Hotel will provide Group a weekly guestroom pickup report starting sixty (60) days prior to the cutoff date, and final room pickup reports with supporting documentation within ten (10) days of departure.
findings.redline_note: Block reviews with adjustment rights and weekly pickup reports are added.

findings.quoted_text: Within ninety (90) days following the conclusion of Group's event on April 16, 2027, the Hotel shall provide Group with a comprehensive post-event report detailing final room block results, attendee counts, revenue by rate category, and itemized charges for all services rendered. This post-event report shall constitute the Hotel's final accounting of Group's stay and shall be deemed accurate and binding unless Group submits written objections within thirty (30) days of receiving the report.
findings.headline: Post-event report in 90 days, deemed binding
findings.finding_text: The report arrives after 90 days rather than 30, with limited content, and is binding unless objected to within 30 days.
findings.cd_standard: Full post-event report within 30 days of departure; late delivery may delay master account payment.
findings.proposed_language: Within thirty (30) days of departure, Hotel will provide a full post-event report, including rooms actualized, a reservation pace report starting 90 days prior to cutoff, suite and double-occupancy usage, a food and beverage revenue recap by Group and affiliate functions, outlet and other spend by attendees on room and master account charges, audio-visual spend, internet bandwidth usage, and exhibitor fees and revenue; failure to provide this report within thirty (30) days may delay payment of the master account.
findings.redline_note: Detailed post-event report is due within thirty days of departure.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall have no right to audit, inspect, or verify the Hotel's room block records, reservation systems, or internal accounting related to Group's event, and Group waives any audit rights it might otherwise possess under applicable law or contract principles.
findings.headline: Group waives all room-block audit rights
findings.finding_text: With no audit, miscoded rooms cannot be credited to pickup, which compounds attrition exposure.
findings.cd_standard: No-cost room-block audit right; miscoded rooms credited to pickup regardless of rate paid.
findings.proposed_language: At Group's request and at no cost, Hotel will compare its in-house guest list against Group's registration list, either jointly with a representative of Group or by permitting a ConferenceDirect or Group representative to do so independently, and Group will keep the list confidential. Any guest room occupied by an individual on Group's registration list but not coded to Group within Hotel's system, including rooms booked at qualified brand-associate or business rates or through Internet distribution channels, will be credited to Group's pickup regardless of the rate paid or reservation method.

findings.quoted_text: Should the National Weather Service issue a hurricane watch or named tropical storm warning that affects the Baltimore, Maryland area during the seventy-two (72) hours preceding the event arrival date of April 12, 2027, or during the event period of April 12-16, 2027, Group shall have the right to cancel this agreement without incurring liquidated damages, provided that such cancellation notice is delivered to the Hotel in writing within twenty-four (24) hours of the issuance of such warning by the National Weather Service.
findings.headline: Storm cancellation only within 24 hours and Group-only
findings.finding_text: The right is limited to Group, requires an official warning, and expires within 24 hours, so it is easily lost; the April event is also outside peak storm season, but the right is still narrower than the standard.
findings.cd_standard: Either party may cancel the affected portion without liability if a named storm is forecast to affect the location within 72 hours of any event date, regardless of damage.
findings.proposed_language: In the event a named storm (hurricane, tropical storm) is forecast to affect the Hotel's location within 72 hours of any event date, either party may cancel the affected portion of the event without liability upon written or verbal (followed by written) notice, regardless of whether the storm ultimately causes physical damage to the Hotel.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group invoke the named storm cancellation right, Group shall forfeit the deposit paid to the Hotel, which shall be retained by the Hotel as partial compensation for the Hotel's lost revenue and costs incurred in preparation for the event.
findings.headline: Deposit forfeited even on a storm cancellation
findings.finding_text: Group loses its deposit despite the cancellation being described as without liquidated damages, which defeats the purpose of the right.
findings.cd_standard: Storm cancellation is without liability.
findings.proposed_language: Should either party cancel under this clause, Hotel will refund all deposits and prepayments made by Group within five (5) days.
findings.redline_note: Deposits are refunded on a named-storm cancellation.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall not be obligated to provide the Group with advance written notice regarding the expiration date, renewal status, or proposed modification of any collective bargaining agreement, union contract, or labor accord to which the Hotel is a party.
findings.headline: No notice of union contract expirations
findings.finding_text: The group learns nothing about labor risk in advance, so it cannot plan around a strike or lockout.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel provides a list of CBA expiration dates a year in advance and notice of any labor dispute within 10 working days.
findings.proposed_language: One (1) year in advance, or within thirty (30) days of signing this Agreement if that is later, Hotel will provide Group in writing a list of all collective bargaining agreement expiration dates for the ensuing year. Hotel will notify Group in writing within ten (10) working days after becoming aware of any labor dispute involving Hotel's employees, including picketing, an expired labor contract, or an existing or impending strike, lockout, or boycott.
findings.redline_note: Hotel provides advance and prompt notice of labor agreements and disputes.
findings.compromise_range: Notice of contract expiry 6–12 months ahead. Cancellation without liability for disputes within 60–90 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: In the event of a labor dispute, strike, work stoppage, lockout, labor action, or other labor-related event affecting the Hotel or its operations, no cancellation window or notice period is defined herein, and the Group shall have no right to cancel this Agreement based upon the occurrence or threatened occurrence of any such labor-related event.
findings.headline: No right to cancel over a strike or lockout
findings.finding_text: A strike or lockout leaves the group bound to the full contract with no exit.
findings.cd_standard: Group may cancel without liability if the union contract expires, picketing, a strike or lockout occurs within 90 days of or during the event, regardless of Hotel's ability to perform.
findings.proposed_language: If, within ninety (90) days prior to or during the Event, Hotel's contract with its union employees has expired, picketing occurs, or a strike or lockout occurs, Group may cancel this Agreement by written notice without liability, regardless of whether Hotel is able to perform. Any deposits or payments made by Group will be promptly refunded. This clause supersedes all other provisions of this Agreement.
findings.compromise_range: Notice of contract expiry 6–12 months ahead. Cancellation without liability for disputes within 60–90 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: The Group acknowledges and agrees that the occurrence of any labor dispute, strike, work stoppage, lockout, job action, or labor-related disruption at the Hotel shall not relieve, excuse, or reduce the Group's obligations under this Agreement, and shall not give rise to any claim for damages, abatement of charges, rate reduction, or credit.
findings.headline: Group keeps paying in full during Hotel labor disruption
findings.finding_text: Group remains liable for every charge even when the Hotel's own labor action disrupts service.
findings.cd_standard: Group may cancel without liability for labor disputes, and the labor clause supersedes other provisions.
findings.proposed_language: A labor dispute, strike, work stoppage, lockout, job action, or labor-related disruption at the Hotel entitles Group to the cancellation right and refund set out in this Agreement and does not relieve Hotel of its obligations to Group.
findings.redline_note: Labor disruption entitles the Group to cancel with a refund.
findings.compromise_range: Notice of contract expiry 6–12 months ahead. Cancellation without liability for disputes within 60–90 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: A service charge and gratuity shall be added to all food and beverage, banquet, and room charges, and the terms 'gratuity' and 'service charge' shall be used interchangeably throughout this Agreement and are not separately defined. The combined gratuity and service charge shall be automatically applied at the rate of twenty-four percent (24%) of the subtotal of all covered charges before tax. Group shall not dispute this automatic application, and the Service Charge shall be due and payable by Group without exception or reduction.
findings.headline: One undefined 24% charge, applied even to room charges
findings.finding_text: Gratuity and service charge are merged, undefined and applied to room charges, so the group cannot tell what is a tip and what is Hotel revenue.
findings.cd_standard: Gratuity (18%) and service charge (6%) separately defined and confirmed; neither added to room rental or equipment already carrying a labor fee.
findings.proposed_language: Eighteen percent (18%) of the food and beverage total, plus applicable tax, will be added to Group's account as a gratuity and fully distributed to the servers, and where applicable, bussers and bartenders assigned to the Event. Any service charge of six percent (6%), plus applicable tax, is separate from gratuity, is not distributed as a tip, and is retained by Hotel to cover the discretionary costs of the Event. Both percentages are confirmed in this Agreement. Hotel will not add a gratuity or service charge to meeting room rental fees, to room charges, or to any rented equipment that also carries a labor fee.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall determine in its sole discretion the allocation and distribution of any gratuity and service charge collected from Group. The Hotel may retain the gratuity and service charge as its own revenue or may distribute a portion or all of it to service staff at the Hotel's election.
findings.headline: Hotel may keep the gratuity instead of paying staff
findings.finding_text: Group pays 24% as a gratuity but the Hotel may keep it all, so staff may receive nothing.
findings.cd_standard: Gratuity fully distributed to the staff who worked the event; service charge disclosed as Hotel revenue.
findings.proposed_language: The gratuity will be fully distributed to the servers, and where applicable, bussers and bartenders assigned to the Event. Any separate service charge is retained by Hotel and is not distributed as a tip.
findings.redline_note: Gratuity goes to event staff; any service charge is disclosed as Hotel revenue.

findings.quoted_text: In the event the Hotel is unable to provide accommodations to any guest for whom a reservation has been guaranteed under this Agreement, the Hotel shall make a reasonable effort to secure alternative lodging at the guest's sole expense and cost. Any booking made by the Hotel at an alternative hotel shall be confirmed in writing to the guest, and the guest shall bear all costs associated with such alternative accommodations, including but not limited to room rates, taxes, and resort fees charged by the substitute hotel.
findings.headline: Walked guests pay for their own replacement lodging
findings.finding_text: The Hotel can overbook and push the cost of alternative lodging onto the attendee, with no advance contact or do-not-walk list.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel contacts Group in advance, walks Group last, honors a do-not-walk list, and pays for comparable accommodations for each displaced guest.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel is unable to accommodate any member of Group holding a confirmed reservation, Hotel will contact Group in advance, will not walk members of Group before transient guests and other groups, and will review Group's attendee list with Group to identify those who cannot be walked under any circumstances. For each displaced guest, Hotel will, at its own expense, provide accommodations at a comparable hotel as close as possible, at no charge to the guest, for each night the guest is displaced, and will credit Group's master account $200 for each night a guest is relocated, regardless of that guest's rate. If Hotel walks ten (10) or more guests, or ten percent (10%) or more of the contracted peak-night block, Hotel will owe Group reasonable additional compensation.
findings.redline_note: Hotel covers comparable lodging for any walked guest and credits the group.

findings.quoted_text: All transportation to and from any alternative hotel, including airport transfers, shall be the guest's own responsibility and expense, and the Hotel shall have no obligation to arrange, provide, or reimburse for any transportation costs incurred by the guest. The guest shall make all arrangements for such transportation independently.
findings.headline: No transportation provided to the substitute hotel
findings.finding_text: Walked attendees must arrange and fund their own transport between hotels.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel provides complimentary round-trip ground transportation for each displaced day and forwards messages, mail and packages.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will provide complimentary round-trip ground transportation between the Hotel and the alternate hotel for each day the guest is displaced, and will forward the displaced guest's telephone messages, mail, and packages.
findings.redline_note: Hotel provides round-trip transportation and message forwarding for walked guests.

findings.quoted_text: Upon the Group's return to the Harborview Grand Hotel following any relocation, the relocated guest shall be assigned to a standard guest room without any upgrade, suite premium, room enhancement, or additional amenity as compensation for the inconvenience of relocation. The guest shall receive no reduction in room rate, no complimentary services, and no credit toward future stays.
findings.headline: No upgrade or amenity for a walked guest
findings.finding_text: The guest receives nothing in return for being displaced.
findings.cd_standard: Upgraded accommodations if available and a welcome amenity from the General Manager on return.
findings.proposed_language: When the guest returns, Hotel will provide upgraded accommodations if available and a welcome amenity from the General Manager.
findings.redline_note: Walked guests receive an upgrade and welcome amenity on return.

findings.quoted_text: Each night during which a guest's guaranteed reservation was relocated to an alternative hotel shall not be credited toward the Group's room pickup, occupancy count, or commission calculation, and such nights shall be excluded entirely from all metrics used to measure the Group's performance under the terms of this Agreement.
findings.headline: Walked nights excluded from pickup and commission
findings.finding_text: The Hotel's own overbooking causes pickup shortfall and attrition charges for the group, with commission also lost.
findings.cd_standard: Each displaced room credited toward pickup and commissionable; no attrition liability on any night a guest is walked.
findings.proposed_language: Each displaced room will be credited toward Group's final pickup and remain commissionable at the group rate, and Group will not be liable for attrition damages if any guest is walked on any night.
findings.redline_note: Walked nights count toward pickup and commission, with no attrition for those nights.

findings.quoted_text: All invoiced charges to the master account shall be due in full upon presentation, and the Group waives any right to dispute or withhold payment of billed amounts after receipt of an invoice from the Hotel. Invoices rendered by the Hotel shall be deemed final and binding as to all line items, including room charges, food and beverage costs, facility rentals, service charges, and ancillary fees, unless the Group provides written notice of a discrepancy within the timeframe specified in the master account documentation.
findings.headline: Group waives right to dispute invoices; no dispute window
findings.finding_text: Payment is due on presentation with no real dispute period, and the dispute timeframe points to documentation outside the contract.
findings.cd_standard: Payable on receipt of invoice, with 30 days to review and dispute in good faith before any finance charge accrues on disputed amounts.
findings.proposed_language: If Group's credit is approved, the master account is payable upon receipt of invoice. Group will have thirty (30) days from receipt of the final itemized invoice to review and dispute any charge in good faith before any finance charge accrues on the disputed amount.
findings.redline_note: Group has thirty days to review and dispute charges before finance charges accrue.
findings.compromise_range: Finance charge capped at 1–1.5% per month, after a dispute window of at least 30 days.

findings.quoted_text: Should the Group fail to remit full payment of undisputed invoiced amounts by the date due, a monthly finance charge of 1.5% shall accrue on the unpaid balance, calculated from the due date until payment is received in full by the Hotel. This finance charge shall compound monthly and shall be added to the master account statement without further notice.
findings.headline: 1.5% monthly compounding finance charge
findings.finding_text: The finance charge is higher than the 1% cap and compounds monthly.
findings.cd_standard: Finance charge not to exceed 1% per month or the legal maximum, on unpaid undisputed balance.
findings.proposed_language: Should the Group fail to remit full payment of undisputed invoiced amounts within thirty (30) days of the final invoice, a finance charge not to exceed one percent (1.0%) per month, or the maximum allowed by law, whichever is less, will apply to the unpaid, undisputed balance.
findings.compromise_range: Finance charge capped at 1–1.5% per month, after a dispute window of at least 30 days.

findings.quoted_text: Where the Hotel has not approved credit for the Group, the Hotel may require prepayment in such amount as the Hotel determines to be appropriate before rooms are held, facilities are reserved, or services are rendered. The Group acknowledges that the determination of any required prepayment amount is within the Hotel's sole discretion and shall be binding on the Group upon written notice.
findings.headline: Hotel sets prepayment amount at its sole discretion
findings.finding_text: The prepayment is open-ended and set unilaterally, with no automatic credit if the Hotel fails to process an application.
findings.cd_standard: Credit extended automatically if Hotel fails to send or follow up on a credit application; if denied, staged deposits of 25%/25%/50%.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel fails to send Group a credit application, or fails to send a written reminder to complete it, Hotel will extend credit to Group. If credit is denied, Group will pay twenty-five percent (25%) of estimated charges within fourteen (14) business days of the denial, twenty-five percent (25%) one (1) month prior to the Event, and fifty percent (50%) three (3) days before the Event.
findings.redline_note: Credit is extended if no application is sent; any prepayment follows a staged schedule.
findings.compromise_range: Finance charge capped at 1–1.5% per month, after a dispute window of at least 30 days.

findings.quoted_text: Upon release of any room inventory or function space by Group, whether through attrition, cancellation, or other reduction of Group's commitment, the Hotel shall have no obligation to attempt to resell such released inventory or function space, nor shall the Hotel be required to undertake any specific actions, marketing efforts, or promotional activities directed toward filling released space.
findings.headline: Hotel has no duty to resell released rooms
findings.finding_text: Hotel may let rooms sit empty and still charge the full damages.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel has an affirmative, documented duty to market and resell canceled rooms and functions through all channels.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will undertake all reasonable efforts to resell canceled rooms and food and beverage functions, and will document in writing its efforts to market the dates proactively through all group and transient channels, including offering the canceled rooms through Hotel's reservations department.
findings.redline_note: Hotel will make and document reasonable efforts to resell released rooms and space.
findings.compromise_range: Cancellation damages due 30–60 days after the meeting dates.

findings.quoted_text: Any revenue generated by the Hotel from the resale or release of rooms or function space originally committed to Group shall be retained in full by the Hotel as additional revenue beyond what Group owes under the terms of this agreement, including without limitation attrition charges, cancellation damages, or any other fees or charges assessed herein. Resale proceeds shall not be credited, offset, or applied against Group's outstanding obligations to the Hotel, and the Hotel shall have no duty to track, account for, or allocate resale revenue in any manner.
findings.headline: Resale proceeds kept by Hotel, not credited against damages
findings.finding_text: Hotel collects damages and resale revenue for the same rooms, a double recovery.
findings.cd_standard: Resale revenue credited against attrition or cancellation damages owed, up to the full amount of those damages.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will credit revenues from the resale of rooms or function space originally committed to Group against any cancellation or attrition damages owed by Group, not to exceed the full amount of such damages. Cancellation damages, if any, are due thirty (30) days after the meeting dates, provided Hotel supplies reasonable evidence of its mitigation efforts and that the rooms and space held for Group went unsold.
findings.compromise_range: Cancellation damages due 30–60 days after the meeting dates.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel's resale efforts, the terms at which resale accommodations are offered to other customers, the identity of parties to whom space is resold, the rate at which such space is resold, and the complete records related to all resale transactions shall not be open to Group for inspection, audit, or verification of any kind. Group shall have no right to request, receive, or review documentation concerning the Hotel's resale activities, and Group shall waive any claim that the Hotel has failed to mitigate damages through inadequate resale efforts or unfavorable resale pricing.
findings.headline: Resale records closed to Group; mitigation claims waived
findings.finding_text: Group cannot verify mitigation or challenge inadequate resale.
findings.cd_standard: Mitigation records, including actual occupancy reports, available to Group on request.
findings.proposed_language: All Hotel records relating to mitigation, including actual occupancy reports, will be made available to Group upon request.
findings.redline_note: Mitigation and occupancy records are available to Group on request.
findings.compromise_range: Cancellation damages due 30–60 days after the meeting dates.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall assign all function space for the Group's use during the Event at the Hotel's sole discretion, and no function room is named or reserved in this Agreement. The Group acknowledges that the Hotel retains the right to change any function space assignment at any time by written notice to the Group's authorized representative, provided that such reassignment shall not materially diminish the aggregate square footage or suitability of space made available to the Group.
findings.headline: Function rooms unnamed and changeable at Hotel's discretion
findings.finding_text: No rooms, square footage or ceiling heights are fixed in the body, and the Hotel may reassign unilaterally; Exhibit A lists rooms only tentatively and without sizes.
findings.cd_standard: Each function room named with minimum square footage and ceiling height; no change without both parties' written consent.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will hold the meeting and function space set out in this Agreement, with room rental charges waived, and will specify each function space assignment, minimum square footage, and ceiling height requirement in this Agreement. No change will be made to the function space assignments without the written consent of both parties.
findings.redline_note: Function rooms are specified with sizes and changed only by mutual written consent.

findings.quoted_text: The Group shall pay all applicable rental charges for meeting rooms and function space utilized during the Event, calculated according to the Hotel's standard pricing schedule in effect at the time of booking.
findings.headline: Meeting room rental charged at standard pricing
findings.finding_text: The group pays rental on all function space, with no waiver and no basic equipment included.
findings.cd_standard: Program-agenda meeting space complimentary with rental waived; microphone, podium, power, lighting and HVAC free in each room.
findings.proposed_language: Meeting space outlined in Group's program agenda will be provided on a complimentary basis, with room rental charges waived. Hotel will provide in each meeting room, at no charge, one wired microphone, a podium, power (including existing power outlets), proper lighting, and HVAC.
findings.redline_note: Agenda meeting space is complimentary with basic room equipment included.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall provide no credit, reduction, or waiver of function space rental fees regardless of Group's use of in-house audio-visual services, catering packages, or other Hotel services.
findings.headline: No rental waiver regardless of services purchased
findings.finding_text: Even with substantial F&B and AV spend, room rental is never waived.
findings.cd_standard: Meeting space complimentary with room rental waived.
findings.proposed_language: Function space rental fees are waived for all meeting space outlined in Group's program agenda.
findings.redline_note: Function space rental is waived for agenda meeting space.

findings.quoted_text: In the event the Hotel wrongfully cancels this Agreement, the Hotel's sole obligation and the Group's exclusive remedy shall be the refund of any deposits paid by the Group to the Hotel, without interest and without liability for any other costs, losses, or damages incurred by the Group in connection with the event. The Hotel shall not be liable for any consequential, incidental, indirect, or special damages, including but not limited to lost profits, reputational harm, or costs associated with event rescheduling or venue relocation.
findings.headline: Wrongful Hotel cancellation limited to deposit refund
findings.finding_text: If the Hotel cancels without a right to do so, the group's only remedy is its deposit back while it bears relocation and rebooking costs, in contrast to its own uncapped liability.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel owes direct, indirect and consequential damages including staff time and travel, rate and airfare differences, space rental, attorney's fees, and communication and printing costs.

findings.quoted_text: In any dispute arising from cancellation by the Hotel, whether lawful or wrongful, the Group shall bear its own attorney's fees, court costs, and other legal expenses, and the Group waives any right to recover such fees or costs from the Hotel notwithstanding the outcome of any proceeding. This allocation of fees shall apply regardless of whether the Hotel's cancellation is determined to be authorized under this Agreement or contrary to its terms.
findings.headline: Group bears its own legal costs even if Hotel breaches
findings.finding_text: The group waives recovery of attorney's fees even when the Hotel wrongfully cancels.
findings.cd_standard: Attorney's fees are among the damages the Hotel owes on an unauthorized cancellation.

findings.quoted_text: Reservations for rooms within the block committed for the National Association of Coastal Engineers event shall be accepted by the Hotel only when received on or before forty-five (45) days prior to the arrival date of April 12, 2027.
findings.headline: Cutoff 45 days before arrival, well ahead of 21
findings.finding_text: A 45-day cutoff closes the block 24 days earlier than the 21-day standard, giving attendees less time to book.
findings.cd_standard: Cutoff 21 days or fewer before arrival.
findings.proposed_language: Reservations for rooms within the block committed for the National Association of Coastal Engineers event shall be accepted by the Hotel at the group rate when received on or before twenty-one (21) days prior to the arrival date of April 12, 2027.
findings.redline_note: Cutoff date is moved closer to arrival.
findings.compromise_range: 21–30 days before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: Any reservation request received after the cutoff date of forty-five (45) days prior to arrival shall be offered accommodations, if available, only at the Hotel's prevailing rack rate in effect at the time of booking, with no access to the negotiated group rate regardless of the reason for the late request. The Hotel shall have no obligation to hold inventory beyond the cutoff date, and rooms not reserved by that date shall be released to the Hotel's general inventory for sale at the Hotel's sole discretion.
findings.headline: Group rate lost after cutoff; unassigned rooms released unilaterally
findings.finding_text: After cutoff, attendees pay rack rate and unassigned rooms are released at the Hotel's discretion, which also increases attrition exposure.
findings.cd_standard: Group rate continues while Hotel sells rooms to the public; unassigned rooms held on prepayment, refunded if later paid, or released after consultation with Group.
findings.proposed_language: After the cutoff date, Hotel will continue to hold any rooms in Group's block not assigned to a specific attendee if Group pays for them in full at that time, and will refund those advance payments after the Event for any such rooms later paid for by Group attendees; alternatively, after consultation with Group, Hotel will offer unassigned rooms to other individuals or groups to reduce any damages Group may owe under the attrition clause. Group members may continue to reserve rooms at the group rate for as long as Hotel is selling rooms to the general public, regardless of room type; once the room block has sold, Hotel will honor the group rate for as long as it is selling the contracted room type to the general public.
findings.redline_note: Group rate continues after cutoff and unassigned rooms are handled in consultation with Group.
findings.compromise_range: 21–30 days before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: Each individual attendee's reservation shall be held at the rate negotiated for the Group, provided that the reservation remains in the attendee's original name. A name change on any individual reservation shall be treated as a new reservation at the Hotel's prevailing rate for comparable accommodations on the relevant dates, and the attendee shall be responsible for any rate difference between the Group rate and the prevailing rate.
findings.headline: Name changes repriced at prevailing rate
findings.finding_text: A name change forfeits the group rate and creates a rate difference for the attendee.
findings.cd_standard: Name changes allowed at the group rate any time up to and including arrival; confirmations within 4 days.
findings.proposed_language: Each individual attendee's reservation shall be held at the rate negotiated for the Group. Name changes may be made to room reservations at the group rate at any time up to and including the arrival date. Upon request, Hotel will send each registered guest confirmation of their reservation, and of any change to it, at no charge within four (4) days of receiving the information, or within two (2) business days if the request is received within thirty (30) days of arrival.
findings.redline_note: Name changes keep the group rate and confirmations are provided promptly.

findings.quoted_text: An attendee who fails to arrive on the first night of his or her reservation shall be deemed to have no-showed, and the Hotel shall cancel the whole remaining reservation for that attendee without further notice or obligation to the attendee or the Group.
findings.headline: First-night no-show cancels the entire stay
findings.finding_text: A late arrival loses all remaining nights, reducing pickup and increasing attrition risk.
findings.cd_standard: No-shows reinstated for the following night at the same rate unless Group directs otherwise.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will reinstate no-shows for the following night at the rate of their existing reservation unless Group directs otherwise.
findings.redline_note: No-shows are reinstated for the following night at the existing rate.

findings.quoted_text: Individual reservations may be cancelled by the attendee or by the Group, without penalty or charge, only if written notice of cancellation is received by the Hotel's group reservations department more than seventy-two hours prior to the scheduled arrival date of the attendee. Individual reservations cancelled within seventy-two hours of arrival are charged one night's room and tax, which charge shall be non-refundable and shall be the sole remedy available to the Hotel for such late cancellation.
findings.headline: Cancellation needs more than 72 hours' written notice
findings.finding_text: Attendees lose a night within 72 hours of arrival, versus free cancellation until 6 pm on arrival day, and any money kept is not credited against attrition.
findings.cd_standard: No fee for cancellation before 6 pm on arrival day; deposits refundable with 3 working days' notice; cancellation money credited against attrition.
findings.proposed_language: No cancellation fee will be assessed for any room cancelled before 6:00 p.m. on the day of arrival. Any individual reservation deposit will be refunded if notice of cancellation is received at least three (3) working days before arrival, and any individual cancellation money Hotel receives will be credited toward any attrition damages owed by Group.
findings.redline_note: Cancellation is free until arrival-day evening and retained amounts credit against attrition.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group cancel this agreement at any time after execution by the parties, Group shall be liable to the Hotel for liquidated damages calculated as a percentage of gross room revenue that would have been earned by the Hotel for all guest rooms for all nights within the event period of April 12-16, 2027, based upon the negotiated room rate and the full room block size.
findings.headline: Damages on gross room revenue for the full block
findings.finding_text: Damages use gross revenue on the full block, not 70% of the net rate on the block less allowable attrition. At the contracted 680 room nights x $289, 100% is about $196,520 versus about $137,564 on a room-profit basis.
findings.cd_standard: 100% of room profit is 70% of the single net group rate x final adjusted block less allowable attrition.
findings.proposed_language: Should Group cancel this agreement after execution by the parties, Group shall be liable to the Hotel for liquidated damages calculated as a percentage of room profit on a sliding scale based on the date written notice of cancellation is received. One hundred percent (100%) of room profit is defined as seventy percent (70%) of the confirmed single net group rate at the time of cancellation, multiplied by the final adjusted room block less allowable attrition.
findings.redline_note: Damages are calculated on room profit rather than gross revenue.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall provide Group with a detailed invoice of damages within forty-five (45) days following the cancellation notice, itemizing the calculation of gross room revenue and the applicable percentage to be assessed.
findings.headline: Damages invoice itemizes gross revenue, not profit
findings.finding_text: The invoicing language is built on gross room revenue and must follow the revised basis.
findings.cd_standard: Dollar amount at each tier stated; calculated on room profit.
findings.proposed_language: The Hotel shall provide Group with a detailed invoice of damages within forty-five (45) days following the cancellation notice, itemizing the calculation of room profit and the applicable percentage to be assessed.
findings.redline_note: Invoice itemizes room profit and the applicable percentage.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall not receive credit toward damages owed for any revenue the Hotel subsequently earns from reselling cancelled rooms or function space, as the Hotel's ability to generate such resale revenue is contingent on market conditions beyond the Hotel's control and shall be retained entirely by the Hotel.
findings.headline: No credit for resold rooms against cancellation damages
findings.finding_text: The Hotel recovers damages and resale revenue for the same rooms.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel resells canceled rooms and credits revenues against damages; any award limited to actual damages with no punitive damages.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will undertake all reasonable efforts to resell canceled rooms and food and beverage functions, and will credit those revenues against the cancellation damages, not to exceed the full amount of such damages. Any award for breach of this Agreement is limited to actual damages; punitive damages will not apply.
findings.redline_note: Resale revenue is credited against cancellation damages.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group elect to rebook with the Hotel at a later date following cancellation of this agreement, such rebooking shall constitute a new and separate commitment and shall earn Group no credit, offset, or other financial benefit against damages that accrued under this cancellation provision prior to the rebooking.
findings.headline: No credit for damages paid if Group rebooks
findings.finding_text: Damages paid on cancellation are never credited toward a later booking.
findings.cd_standard: If a ConferenceDirect client rebooks within 3 years, Hotel credits up to 100% of damages paid toward the new booking, refunded to the paying group if another group rebooks.
findings.proposed_language: Should a ConferenceDirect client rebook the Hotel for another meeting within three (3) years, Hotel will credit up to 100% of the cancellation damages paid toward the new booking's room revenue, not to exceed the damages paid; if the rebooking group is not the group that paid, the credit will be refunded directly to the group that paid.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: Liquidated damages under this clause apply to any cancellation of this agreement at any time after the parties execute this agreement, whether such cancellation occurs months before the event or days before arrival, and no period of time following execution shall be deemed a liability-free window during which cancellation would occur without incurring liquidated damages.
findings.headline: Damages apply from signing, no liability-free window
findings.finding_text: Even a cancellation 365+ days out costs 25%, with no dollar amount stated per tier.
findings.cd_standard: Sliding scale with the dollar amount of each tier stated in the Agreement.
findings.proposed_language: Liquidated damages under this clause apply as set out in the sliding scale below, and the dollar amount owed at each tier is stated in this Agreement.
findings.redline_note: Each tier of the scale states the dollar amount owed.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.headline: Early cancellation tier is a percentage of gross revenue
findings.finding_text: Tier percentages apply to gross revenue, and no dollar amounts are stated. Tier figures should be restated as percentages of room profit with dollar amounts disclosed.
findings.cd_standard: Percentage of room profit on a sliding scale with dollar amounts stated.
findings.proposed_language: 25% of room profit (stated in dollars in this Agreement)
findings.redline_note: Tier is restated against room profit with the dollar amount shown.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: Attrition is measured on a night-by-night basis, with shortfalls calculated by comparing actual rooms occupied to the block size on each night of the event period. Group shall be deemed in attrition if actual occupancy falls below the attrition threshold of ninety percent (90%) on any night.
findings.headline: Nightly attrition with a 90% trigger
findings.finding_text: Attrition is tested every night against a 90% trigger, versus the cumulative 70% standard, so a single soft night creates liability. The contract's attrition threshold (90%) is also tighter than the block table, which has 170 rooms nightly.
findings.cd_standard: Attrition measured cumulatively across the entire block, with liability only if pickup falls below 70% of the total block.
findings.proposed_language: Attrition liability, if any, will be calculated on a cumulative (not night-by-night) basis, with liability triggered only if Group's actual pickup falls below seventy percent (70%) of the total contracted room block.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group's occupancy fall below ninety percent (90%) on any night during the event period, Group shall be liable for attrition damages at the rate of one hundred percent (100%) of the nightly room rate for each unoccupied room within the block. This liability shall be calculated by multiplying the nightly room rate by the number of occupied rooms multiplied by the applicable damage rate, and such damages shall be assessed for each night on which the threshold is not met.
findings.headline: Attrition at 100% of rate per unoccupied room each night
findings.finding_text: Damages are 100% of the room rate rather than 70% lost profit on unsold rooms. The formula in the second sentence multiplies by occupied rooms rather than unoccupied ones, which is internally inconsistent.
findings.cd_standard: For each unsold room night below the 70% threshold, 70% of the single net group rate, limited to rooms the Hotel actually failed to sell.
findings.proposed_language: Should Group's actual pickup fall below seventy percent (70%) of the total contracted room block, Group will pay, for each unsold room night below that threshold, an amount equal to seventy percent (70%) (lost profit) of Group's single confirmed net group rate (plus tax, if required by applicable law), calculated as the lesser of the number of unsold rooms in the Hotel that night or the shortfall between Group's minimum block and actual pickup.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall receive no credit toward its block commitment for nights on which the Hotel sells out all available rooms in the Hotel, and occupancy on such nights shall be deemed to have satisfied the threshold regardless of the actual number of rooms occupied from the block.
findings.headline: No block credit for high-occupancy nights
findings.finding_text: The credit runs only to the Hotel's benefit and requires a full sell-out instead of 95% occupancy.
findings.cd_standard: Any night the Hotel achieves 95% occupancy or higher gives Group full credit toward its block commitment.
findings.proposed_language: For any night the Hotel achieves 95% occupancy or higher, Group will receive full credit toward its block commitment for that night.
findings.redline_note: Group receives block credit on nights the Hotel reaches high occupancy.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel's determination of occupancy, calculation of attrition damages, and assessment of liability shall be final and binding upon Group. The Hotel's occupancy records, registration cards, and room-by-room occupancy logs shall not be open to Group for audit, verification, or inspection, and Group waives any right to independently verify the Hotel's calculations or to contest the Hotel's occupancy records on any basis.
findings.headline: Attrition determination final; Group cannot audit records
findings.finding_text: Group cannot verify the calculation, with no formula safeguard or F&B or rebook credits.
findings.cd_standard: Audit rights; formula-based damages; payment settles all room-block damages; F&B excess credited against attrition; rebook credit.
findings.proposed_language: At Group's request, Hotel will provide a copy of its city ledger or daily report showing the information needed to verify the calculation. After receipt of this payment, Hotel will not seek additional damages from Group related to the room block commitment. Any excess food and beverage revenue above Group's F&B minimum will be credited dollar for dollar against room attrition damages, and vice versa. Should a ConferenceDirect client rebook the Hotel for another meeting within three (3) years, Hotel will credit up to 100% of the attrition damages paid toward the new booking's room revenue, not to exceed the damages paid.
findings.redline_note: Group may verify the calculation and receives offsets and rebook credit.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: Neither party shall be liable to the other for failure to perform its obligations under this agreement when such failure results from causes beyond the reasonable control of the performing party, provided that the event rendered performance physically impossible and was not foreseeable at the time of agreement execution.
findings.headline: Force majeure limited to physical impossibility
findings.finding_text: The group cannot cancel for illegality, impracticability, safety concerns or 20% attendee loss.
findings.cd_standard: Either party may cancel without liability where performance is illegal, impossible, commercially impracticable or inadvisable, or attendance would fall by 20% or more.

findings.quoted_text: Force majeure events are limited to occurrences such as war, acts of terrorism, earthquakes, floods, or similar extraordinary natural events that render performance of this agreement objectively impossible without regard to economic hardship, inconvenience, or increased cost.
findings.headline: Narrow list of force majeure events
findings.finding_text: The enumerated events omit disease, travel advisories, government closures and emergency declarations.
findings.cd_standard: Qualifying causes explicitly include terrorism, disease and epidemics, CDC and government travel advisories, government closures and emergency declarations, and government, corporate and educational travel restrictions.

findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this agreement, the following shall not constitute force majeure: government-issued travel restrictions, travel advisories, or governmental directives limiting group gatherings or travel, regardless of the reason such restrictions or advisories are issued; epidemics, pandemics, or declarations of public health emergency, including any government responses thereto; or concerns among Group members regarding attendee safety, willingness to travel, or health considerations.
findings.headline: Epidemics, advisories and safety concerns excluded
findings.finding_text: The exclusions remove the protections CD treats as core.
findings.cd_standard: Epidemics, advisories, government restrictions and health or safety concerns are qualifying causes.

findings.quoted_text: The invocation of force majeure by either party shall not relieve Group of its obligations to remit the deposit and initial payment to the Hotel, which shall be retained by the Hotel despite any termination of this agreement resulting from force majeure.
findings.headline: Deposits kept by Hotel after force majeure
findings.finding_text: Group loses its deposit when force majeure ends the contract.
findings.cd_standard: Deposits refunded promptly; if Group holds a smaller meeting, Hotel waives attrition, F&B and rental fees and offers the lowest rate it offers anyone.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel's only obligation upon occurrence of force majeure shall be to release Group from performance obligations prospectively; no refund or credit shall be issued for payments previously made.
findings.headline: No refund or credit after force majeure
findings.finding_text: Prior payments are retained entirely by the Hotel.
findings.cd_standard: Deposits refunded promptly.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel retains the absolute right to sell rooms to the general public at any rate, including rates below the rate offered to Group. The Hotel's pricing to the public shall not be limited by, constrained by, or subordinate to the rate offered to Group, and Group waives any claim that lower public rates violate any rate parity or rate protection provision.
findings.headline: Hotel may undercut the group rate freely
findings.finding_text: There is no parity guarantee at all, and the group rate is not protected against other groups' rates.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel will not sell rooms below the group rate during the event dates (except qualified rates), and the group rate is no higher than any other group's within 7 days either side.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel guarantees it will not sell guestrooms at a rate lower than Group's contracted group rate during the Event dates, with the exception of qualified rates (government, airline, and contracted corporate negotiated rates). Hotel further agrees that Group's rate will be no higher than the group rate given to any other group over the period from seven (7) days before through seven (7) days after the room block dates.
findings.compromise_range: Group rate no higher than other groups' rates within 3–7 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: Should the Hotel identify that it has sold rooms to the general public at a rate lower than Group's negotiated rate, any rate adjustment applied to Group's block shall be effective only for future reservations made after the Hotel has identified and approved the lower rate. No retroactive adjustment to Group's rate shall apply to reservations already confirmed prior to the date on which the lower rate is identified. Group's liability for rooms reserved at the original rate shall not be reduced or eliminated by the Hotel's subsequent discovery of lower public rates.
findings.headline: No retroactive rate adjustment for existing reservations
findings.finding_text: Attendees already booked keep paying the higher rate.
findings.cd_standard: Rate adjusted for all prior reservations in the block to match.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel offers a lower guestroom rate, Hotel will adjust the rate for all prior reservations in Group's block to match and make the adjusted rate available to all Group attendees.
findings.compromise_range: Group rate no higher than other groups' rates within 3–7 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: Any rate adjustment determined by the Hotel to apply to Group's block shall be treated as a non-commissionable rate for purposes of Group's commission or rebate structure under this Agreement. An adjusted rate shall not count toward Group's room block pickup calculations, occupancy targets, or any other metric used to measure Group's performance against block commitments. The adjusted rate shall be invoiced at the new rate, but the Hotel shall make no adjustment to complimentary rooms, attrition calculations, or other block-based benefits.
findings.headline: Adjusted-rate rooms lose commission and pickup credit
findings.finding_text: Group is penalized for the Hotel's own discounting through lost commission, lower pickup and no change to attrition.
findings.cd_standard: Commission paid on the contracted rate regardless of adjustment; rooms remain creditable toward pickup, complimentary rooms, attrition and other pickup-based concessions.
findings.proposed_language: Commission will be paid on the contracted rate regardless of any rate adjustment, and such rooms remain creditable toward Group's pickup, complimentary-room credits, attrition, and any other concession based on pickup.
findings.redline_note: Adjusted-rate rooms keep commission and pickup credit.
findings.compromise_range: Group rate no higher than other groups' rates within 3–7 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: Staffing at food and beverage functions, including the assignment of servers, bartenders, runners, and other service personnel, is at the Hotel's discretion and shall be determined by the Hotel based on the number of attendees, the complexity of the menu, the duration of the function, and the Hotel's operational requirements.
